{{Quote|You'll be sitting right across from me, where I can keep an ''eye'' on you.|Blackout, to Spark|<ref name="CaM" />}}
'''Blackout''' was a [[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|stealth operations clone trooper]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] assigned to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] towards the middle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to fight during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. Blackout was one of the crew of a [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]] along with [[Spark/Legends|Spark]]. His helmet was decorated with [[Jaig eyes|''jaig'' eyes]], a battle honor given to those that have shown bravery on the field.

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Blackout was a member of the crew assigned to an experimental stealth ship, under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Fleet]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]].<ref name="CaM" /> He also served as a mentor for clone rookie [[Spark/Legends|Spark]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Hasbro]] made an action figure of Blackout. Though it was named Stealth Operations Clone Trooper, the mold and features were clearly of Blackout.
